text.p: Brisbane: Queensland beat Victoria by eight wickets. Queensland 305 (Andrew Symonds 77) and 137-2 (Matthew Hayden 73 not out). Victoria 162 (Andrew Bichel 5-46) and 277 (Warren Ayres 56, Brad Hodge 51; Andrew Bichel 5-69).

Adelaide: Western Australia beat South Australia by five wickets. Western Australia 318 (Justin Langer 116, Damien Martyn 96) and 288-5 (Tom Moody 89 not out). South Australia 277 and 325 (James Brayshaw 96, Geoff Parker 80).

Hobart: Tasmania and New South Wales drew. New South Wales 403-9 dec. (Brad McNamara 137 not out) and 225-3 dec. (Shane Lee 101 not out, Kevin Roberts 54). Tasmania 327-9 dec. (Shaun Young 108 not out, Michael DiVenuto 50) and 268-9 (David Boon 77, Jamie Cox 67).
